summary: The comment urges schools to be transparent with parents about online content that encourages gender transition and to allow parents to understand and raise concerns.

claims.requested_action: Require schools to disclose and explain online content related to gender transition and allow parental concerns
claims.argument: Schools should provide parents with clear information about online content that encourages gender transition so parents can make informed decisions.
